title: Minimum-Distortion Wealth Taxation, I: Information-Theoretic versus Transport-Geometric Optimality on the Proportional Class
abstract: arXiv:2608.23576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We characterise minimum-distortion wealth taxation under two contrasting normative criteria within a Fokker-Planck framework on log-wealth: the JKO free-energy gap, an information-theoretic measure aligned with the Mirrleesian decision-distortion tradition, and the squared 2-Wasserstein distance from the no-tax distribution at horizon $T$, a transport-geometric measure aligned with the Saez-Zucman distributional-compression tradition. Restricting to the neutrality-preserving (C1)-(C3) schedule class of a companion paper (Froseth 2026), both optima admit closed forms in the two-dimensional design plane parametrised by the corporate-dividend retention $k = (1-\tau_c)(1-\tau_d)$ and the proportional wealth-tax rate $\tau_w$. The JKO optimum partitions the regime axis into three phases as a function of the dimensionless ratio $\rho = \Sigma_0 m_0/\sigma^2$, with $m_0 = \mu - \sigma^2/2$ the geometric mean log-return: a pure wealth-tax phas

translated_title: 最小扭曲财富税 I：比例类别上信息论与传输几何最优性
translated_abstract: 我们基于对数财富的Fokker-Planck框架，在两种对比规范标准下刻画了最小扭曲财富税：JKO自由能间隙（一种与Mirrleesian决策扭曲传统一致的信息论度量）以及从无税分布到时间T的平方2-Wasserstein距离（一种与Saez-Zucman分布压缩传统一致的传输几何度量）。限制于伴随论文（Froseth 2026）中保持中性的（C1）-（C3）计划类别，两个最优解在由公司股息留存k = (1-τ_c)(1-τ_d)和比例财富税率τ_w参数化的二维设计平面内均具有封闭形式。JKO最优解根据无量纲比ρ = Σ_0 m_0/σ^2（其中m_0 = μ - σ^2/2为几何平均对数收益）将制度轴划分为三个相位：纯财富税相位...
tldr: 本文在Fokker-Planck框架下，针对比例财富税类别，分别基于信息论（JKO自由能间隙）和传输几何（2-Wasserstein距离）两种标准，给出了最小扭曲财富税的封闭形式解，并揭示了JKO最优解随参数变化的三阶段结构。
en_tdlr: This paper derives closed-form minimum-distortion wealth tax solutions under both information-theoretic (JKO free-energy gap) and transport-geometric (2-Wasserstein distance) criteria within a Fokker-Planck framework, revealing a three-phase structure for the JKO optimum as a function of a dimensionless ratio.
